description: Bay Norm: a receiver that carries the eight signals of one Bay Input module anywhere in the patch, falling back to its own input where the source is unpatched

inputs.text: Feeds the output of the same number whenever the port of the same number on the linked Bay Input is unpatched, or no source is linked

outputs.text: Carries the port of the same number on the linked Bay Input, or its own normal input when that source port is unpatched

notes: nothing arrives from elsewhere in the patch until a Bay Input is picked in Bay Norm source; until then each output carries its own normal input
menu: Bay Norm source — picks which Bay Input this module receives from, each listed by its name and module id, or None
Bay Norm name — a text field naming this module; the name is drawn at the top of the panel
Enable 0 channel output — gives a port with no source and no normal a cable of no channels, which a destination treats as no cable rather than as 0V
